summary: Connect recovery to applicability, judgment and next responsibility; add a scoped engineering-orientation method card.

core/docs/methods/cards/model-engineerin: 接到 Harness 的记录与证据

revisit: At recovery, check whether assumptions, evidence and decisions still apply and assign the next responsibility. When a study uses model engineering, map actual stages, consumed objects and evidence; do not force four training stages on all research.
acceptance: Retain old scientific judgments and model states. Record justified current/next-gate adaptations and any unresolved runtime evidence. New runs require their own bounded reason and plan.
